sloka: एतेनाराधितो ब्रह्मा तपसा भावितात्मना।अस्त्राणि चाप्यवाप्तानि रिपवश्च पराजिताः ।। ६.७१.३१ ।।
transliteration: etenārādhito brahmā tapasā bhāvitātmanā।astrāṇi cāpyavāptāni ripavaśca parājitāḥ ।। 6.71.31 ।।

translations.english: "By penance on supreme self he propitiated Brahma, who blessed him with mystic missiles by way of boons by which his enemies were subdued."
